name: Short Multiphasic Personality Inventory (Mini-Mult)
description: Mini-Mult is a shortened version of the MMPI with 71 questions and 11 scales, 3 of which are validity scales. The first three measure the person's sincerity, how reliable the results are and the correction introduced by excessive caution. The other 8 are clinical scales that assess personality traits. There is no time limit.
instruction: Below are statements about your health and your character. Read each one and decide whether it is true or false for you. Don't spend time thinking it over: the most natural answer is the one that comes to mind first. If a statement is true for you, press "Yes". If it is not true for you, press "No".

summaries.Лица чрезмерно открытые, не скрывающие с: People who are overly open and don't hide their difficulties, weaknesses or psychological problems. They are well aware of their difficulties and tend to exaggerate rather than underestimate interpersonal conflicts, the severity of their symptoms and their own inadequacy. A tendency to be critical of themselves and others leads to scepticism. Dissatisfaction and a tendency to exaggerate conflicts make the person easily hurt and cause awkwardness in relationships.
summaries.Показатели по шкале лжи в норме: Lie scale within the normal range
summaries.Тенденция испытуемого представить себя в:
The person tends to present themselves in a better light by showing strict adherence to social norms. This may be because of:
a limited outlook, or
the situation, or
pathology, or
a habit of following set standards of behaviour, sometimes observing minor rules of little real value;
belonging to a professional group whose work demands an exceptionally high standard of behaviour and strict adherence to conventions (lawyers, teachers).
For people with high intelligence and wide life experience, this score should not be read as a wish to look good.
If other scales also show peaks, the profile can only be interpreted together with known clinical data.
summaries.Показатели по шкале достоверности в норм: Validity scale within the normal range
summaries.Производит впечатление человека благораз: Comes across as sensible, friendly and sociable with a wide range of interests. Extensive experience of interpersonal contact and denial of difficulties give them fairly high enterprise and the ability to find the right course of action. Since these qualities improve social adaptation, a moderately raised K score can be seen as a favourable sign.
summaries.Показатели по шкале коррекции в норме: Correction scale within the normal range
summaries.Высокий показатель по шкале \"К\" говори: A high K score suggests the person may shape their behaviour around social approval and be concerned with their social status. They tend to deny any difficulties in relationships or in controlling their own behaviour, try to follow accepted norms and refrain from criticizing others as long as others' behaviour stays within accepted norms. They react negatively to people who clearly deviate from traditions and customs. In a clinical context: marked anxiety and low self-confidence combined with a desire to win others' goodwill.
summaries.Испытуемый не озабочен состоянием своего: The person is not preoccupied with their health, is more active and energetic, and resolves difficulties more successfully using more adaptive behaviour.
summaries.Показатели по шкале ипохондрии в норме: Hypochondria scale within the normal range
summaries.Высокий показатель но шкале \"Hs\" говор: A high Hs score suggests that the person attributes their anxiety not to external social causes but to their physical health. Bodily sensations carry great emotional weight: general well-being, capacity for work, disturbed bodily functions, pain. How anxiety becomes somatized: worry about physical health arises against a background of generally high anxiety. The anxiety is projected onto the heart, blood vessels and digestive tract, becoming somatized and concrete, that is, it turns into fear. Heightened attention to oneself, which shifts the sense of threat from relationships to processes in one's own body, is combined with poor control over emotions. At its peak this becomes a tendency to complain, preoccupation with one's physical state, pessimism and lack of faith in success, especially in medical help, and prolonged, meticulous self-monitoring, which shows outwardly as uncooperativeness, stubbornness and scepticism.
summaries.Низкий уровень тревоги, активность, общи: Low anxiety, activity, sociability and a sense of one's own importance, strength, energy and vitality.
summaries.Показатели по шкале депрессии в норме: Depression scale within the normal range
summaries.Высокий показатель по шкале \"D\" говори:
A high D score suggests the person may be experiencing anxiety more than depression: a sense of vague threat whose nature and timing can't be predicted, diffuse fears and anxious expectations.
How anxiety develops:
a feeling of inner tension and readiness for something unexpected to happen, which is not yet seen as threatening. Growing inner tension often makes it hard to pick out what matters, which shows as an unpleasant mood;
then anxiety turns into fear, a sense of a specific threat and of an inevitable approaching disaster.
To others the person seems pessimistic, withdrawn, quiet, shy and overly serious, and may appear self-absorbed and avoiding contact. In fact they need deep, lasting relationships. They readily identify with particular people and things, and if that identification breaks down they experience it as a disaster that lowers their mood. The mere threat of losing a harmonious relationship can make them anxious, so their reserve is a way to avoid disappointment. In reality they seek to attract and hold others' attention, value others' opinions and try to win and keep them. When frustrated, they tend to turn inwards: guilt, anger directed at themselves, self-harm, even suicide. They respond to maladjustment with fatigue, inertia, passivity and by abandoning self-centred aims in a difficult conflict.
summaries.Интроверсия, скептицизм, недостаточная с: Introversion, scepticism and limited spontaneity in social contact.
summaries.Показатели по шкале истерии в норме: Hysteria scale within the normal range
summaries.Высокий показатель по шкале \"Hy\" говор:
A high Hy score suggests:
The person is able to push away things that cause anxiety and demonstratively emphasizes physical complaints while tending to deny difficulties in social adaptation. This strong capacity for repression removes anxiety effectively but makes it hard to develop stable behaviour: new roles, tasks and judgements keep appearing. People of this type lack a well-developed inner world; their experiences are aimed at an outside observer. Ignoring negative signals from outside keeps their self-esteem high, bordering on self-admiration. This can lead to tactlessness and an uncritical view of situations.
The person wants to be the centre of attention, seeks recognition and support and pursues them persistently. A tendency to fantasize, egocentrism, immaturity and superficial relationships. Usually hinders a group that has to work on a problem steadily over a long time. Tends towards declarations rather than sustained, orderly effort on long tasks. Does better in situations that require quickly changing roles, short contacts and adapting to different people. In conflicts, superficial physical complaints are most often used for self-defence.
In a clinical context: a complete loss of the ability to form stable attitudes and build behaviour on past experience may be seen; the person lives by trial and error, driven by momentary wishes. Weak restraint of wishes leads to aimless, chaotic behaviour. The personality decompensates under heightened demands and pressure, and when relationships that social norms require to be maintained (for example, in the family) break down. Gross conversion symptoms may appear, or subtler changes in autonomic regulation that 'copy' frightening illnesses seen or heard of before (for example, a heart attack). The main aim of such behaviour is the need for attention and support, and for admiration of one's suffering and fortitude.
summaries.Конвенциональная личность, высокий урове: A conventional personality, strongly identified with their social status, tending to keep stable interests, attitudes and goals.
summaries.Показатели по шкале психопатии в норме: Psychopathy scale within the normal range
summaries.Показатели по шкале паранойяльности в но: Paranoia scale within the normal range
summaries.Решительность, гибкость поведения с низк: Decisiveness and flexible behaviour with low anxiety; confident in making decisions.
summaries.Показатели по шкале психастении в норме: Psychasthenia scale within the normal range
summaries.Высокие результаты по шкале \"Pt\" говор:
A high Pt score suggests:
A constitutional predisposition to anxious reactions, with the anxiety kept down by restricting one's behaviour. Sensitivity, fear, anxiety, unfounded worries, lack of confidence in oneself and one's competence, low self-esteem and obsessiveness. An anxious, suspicious personality with a low frustration threshold, tension, self-criticism, empathy, difficulties with social adjustment, shyness and fearfulness. A low capacity for repression and heightened attention to negative signals. A drive to keep even trivial facts in view and to anticipate even unlikely possibilities, so that a situation never seems clear enough, which further increases constant anxiety. The inability to separate background from signal, with the background taking on emotional weight, weakens concentration and leads to doubt and hesitation when a decision is needed, and to anxiety and fear about the consequences of one's actions. Since every new signal is perceived as a threat, the person sticks to tried and tested ways of working.
In their work they are driven mainly not by a need to succeed but by a wish to avoid failure, and their behaviour is shaped by fear of bringing danger on themselves through a wrong move. This fear limits their behaviour, especially where success is not guaranteed. Where they do have to act, they try to control the quality of their work by setting a high internal standard against which actions and results are measured. Others describe them as conscientious, thorough in their duties, reserved and indecisive.
In a clinical context: a tendency towards obsessive worry, tension and indecision, and low resistance to stress. Stressful situations are those where factors change quickly and that are disorderly and can't be planned. Decompensation is accompanied by obsessive fears and rituals.
summaries.Отсутствие шизоидных черт характера (эмо: No schizoid character traits (emotional coldness and detachment).
summaries.Показатели по шкале шизоидности в норме: Schizoid scale within the normal range
summaries.Высокие результаты по шкале \"Sc\" говор:
A high Sc score suggests:
Schizoid type: develops when even minor frustrations lead to lasting negative emotions, and compensation is achieved by withdrawing from the outside world into the inner world. Emotional coldness, unusual perception and judgements, unusual thoughts and actions, and selective or superficial relationships.
Orientation towards internal criteria and loss of the ability to understand others intuitively and put oneself in their place, which disrupts appropriate emotional responses. It is hard, sometimes impossible, for the person to see themselves from outside and place themselves in the world around them. Behaviour is often eccentric, emotionally flat or arrogant. Although negative signals don't usually reach them, when one does it can hurt them unexpectedly deeply. Because a clearly defined picture of a social situation often becomes a source of tension and prolonged, intense negative emotions for them, they avoid clear, precise formulations and have no clear idea of how they should behave in a given situation or what others expect of them.
Although what they say is logical and grammatically correct, others may find it ambiguous or hard to understand, perhaps because disrupted social communication weakens their control over meaning. However, they can excel in fields that use symbols (for example, mathematics). Growing difficulty with socialization can increase inner tension, making it ever harder to assess situations and the world realistically. Their activity therefore usually takes place outside the situation, as they often feel alienated and misunderstood and unable to become a real member of a group they formally belong to. The result is ambivalence in relationships: expecting attention from others while fearing their coldness. They alternate between excessive friendliness and puzzling hostility, and overly intense contact can give way to sudden breaks. Lack of contact also leads to autistic fantasizing and emotionally charged ideas.
summaries.Снижение активности и контактов с людьми: Reduced activity and contact with people.
summaries.Показатели по шкале гипомании в норме: Hypomania scale within the normal range
